summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a 424B5 pricing supplement for a $2,525,000 aggregate principal amount of Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due June 30, 2032. The notes are linked to the worst-performing of the Russell 2000, S&P 500, and EURO STOXX 50 indices, with a contingent coupon feature and automatic call provision. This is a routine debt issuance under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. The notes are senior unsecured obligations with no special structural or strategic corporate event.
